movement_basis: SR169 alone reports 63 confirmations, 32 confirmed deaths (23 community and 9 intra-CTE) and 15 recoveries. Cumulative cases rise by 63 and recoveries by 15. Cumulative deaths rise by 346, comprising 32 daily notifications and 314 retrospective Ituri harmonisation adjustments; do not report 346 as daily mortality. Current zone allocations were revised and are not daily incidence.

health_zone_table.basis: All 67 Tableau 2 cumulative and daily rows visually verified against original pages 2–3; operational tables on pages 4–9 checked. Blanks remain null; printed zeros remain zero. Text-only health-area numbers withheld.

reconciliation.note: Source no longer prints an A ventiler row; all 67 named zone totals now sum to national totals. Ituri was retrospectively harmonised; zone-to-zone revisions must not be interpreted as daily cases or deaths.

preserved_conflicts: SR169 reports cumulative 10414 confirmations versus SR168 10351: an increase of 63, equal to daily 63. Deaths 5372 versus 5026 increase by 346, compared with daily 32: the remaining 314 is retrospective Ituri harmonisation. Recoveries 2803 versus 2788 increase by 15, equal to daily 15.

Cover page 1 reports Ituri harmonisation from 3436 deaths to 3750; province/zone tables print current 3769 and daily 19. The reported sequence reconciles arithmetically as 3436 + 314 retrospective adjustment = 3750; 3750 + 19 daily = 3769. Preserve both baseline and current values with their distinct roles.

Ituri cumulative cases and deaths were reallocated across many zones. All 67 current named zones sum to 10414 cases and 5372 deaths; no A ventiler row is printed. The 493 unallocated deaths in SR168 are historical. Do not derive current zone incidence from revised cumulative differences.
Cover care census 1002 equals five provincial care totals: 401 + 506 + 15 + 32 + 48. The current Ituri confirmed/suspect split is absent, so the national case-status split remains unknown.

Ituri stock-flow arithmetic 422 + 78 - 98 = 402 differs from current 401 by one. Kasenyi did not report; no unreported transfer, death or correction is inferred. Nord-Kivu 546 + 76 - 116 = 506, Tshopo 19 - 4 = 15 and Bas-Uele 38 + 10 = 48 reconcile. Prior-day Haut-Uele care was unreported.
Nord-Kivu occupancy 88.0% uses the 361/410 CTE/CT cohort, excluding 145 of 506 care patients. Do not apply 410 beds to all 506 patients or report 506/410 as occupancy.

Ituri meals 377/391 are separate from 401 care patients. Fourteen reportedly without meals matches the meal-denominator gap 391 - 377; it is not 401 - 377. Kasenyi reporting missingness remains explicit.

SMSPS Ituri 26/28 confirmed-support cohort differs from daily 34 epidemiological confirmations; the source does not explicitly label 26/28 as new. SMSPS 122 confirmed and 190 suspects under follow-up is not the current care 401 split. Nord-Kivu SMSPS data were not transmitted; do not inherit prior-day 25/30 or 17 reintegrations.

Contact follow-up 32306/37674 (85.8%) covers six reporting provinces. The denominator differs from SR168 37367; the printed comparison with 84.5% is not a matched-cohort improvement. Boma Mangbetu 68.9% and Wamba 71.1% are current provincial subcohorts.

PoE/PoC has ten alerts, five validated living suspects and two intercepted bodies. Global fractions are 2/5 suspects transferred, 1/2 bodies swabbed and 3/5 suspects investigated. Three Ituri transfer refusals, the unswabbed body notified in Sud-Kivu, and the pending Ituri swab do not establish confirmed Ebola cases or deaths.

Figure 1 visible caption spans 20 April–30 October 2026. The text layer additionally contains n=X, absent from the visible caption. The embedded raster graph and maps were visually inspected; no onset-series values, graph subset denominator or map-derived counts were reconstructed.

Vaccination cohorts differ: Ituri 134 daily and 2215 cumulative; Nord-Kivu 200 daily and 800 of 7105 cumulative; Bas-Uele compassion cohort 1943 of 13202. Ongoing research language does not establish Bundibugyo vaccine efficacy.

challenges.finding: Tshopo contact follow-up 73.2% amid strike and aggression; Nord-Kivu 81.7%; Haut-Uele 84.9%, Boma Mangbetu 68.9% and Wamba 71.1%. National 85.8% remains below 95%. Butuhe PoC closed and Maboya PoC burned. Sud-Ubangi 335/2237 travelers (15%) refused screening, 23.4% at Akula.

Ituri has 40 critical patients and persistent blood stockout; Kasenyi CTE did not report because of strike. Nord-Kivu has 19 critical patients and 145/506 outside CTE/CT. Bafwasende CTE building burned; two escaped confirmed patients remain missing. Bas-Uele 48 isolated suspects have no functional CTE or nutritional support.

Nord-Kivu: no kits for six decontaminated households, four unopened rings, two infected PPL and 42 postponed safe burials. Ituri: nine unopened rings and 13 swab failures. Bas-Uele: 130/632 staff (20.6%) PCI-WASH trained and 16/20 priority facilities lack functional triage. Haut-Uele: four of seven zones reporting, kits lacking. Tshopo: 49/107 facilities (45.7%) have a triage circuit.

Ituri: 134 vaccinated daily, 2215 cumulatively in ongoing research. Nord-Kivu: 200 vaccinated daily in Beni, 800/7105 cumulatively (11.3%), 2000 doses received and one non-serious MAPI. Bas-Uele: compassion vaccination ended at 1943/13202 (14.7%); UCC inactive. Tshopo PEV continuity plan awaiting activation. No BDBV vaccine efficacy inferred.

Tshopo: three assessments show ineffective triage, no partogram and staff MVE vaccination 0–37.5%; recovery plans for Bethanie and Maison Medicale elaborated. Nord-Kivu Anuarite: no triage, SRO-Zinc, PEP or nutritional supplies; 9/16 staff PCI trained (56.3%), no disruption dashboard or absenteeism contingency. Ituri: blood need 4900 bags/month, 1000 for Bunia/Rwampara. Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and Sud-Ubangi continuity data untransmitted.

Ituri: 15/28 affected zones (53.6%) covered, Mangala 1/2. SMSPS 26/28 confirmed-support cohort differs from 34 epidemiological confirmations. Haut-Uele: no nurseries in Isiro, Pawa, Wamba or Boma Mangbetu; mobility and infant nutrition supplies lacking. Wanie-Rukula staff untrained and lack communications/mobility. Bas-Uele support delayed, no daily intervention reported. Nord-Kivu data untransmitted.

Haut-Uele: 3/5 vehicles received and 460 L fuel. Bas-Uele: five WHO motorcycles received, Buta CTE construction 50%, diesel/computers/printers lacking. Bafwasende CTE building and Maboya PoC cabin burned; Nord-Kivu PCI/EDS escorts and threats against Beach Bolebole staff reported.

Only 3/8 DPS (37.5%) report. Nord-Kivu: mechanism known in 3/34 zones (8.8%) and one partner reports. Haut-Uele: 0/14 partners report, French/Lingala tools lacking. Tshopo: tools lacking and community complaints mechanism incomplete across Kisangani zones.

priorities: Strengthen early detection, contact follow-up and safe burials; source recommendation, not completion.
